# AD&D 2E — Blue

A modern redesign of the AD&D 2nd Edition character sheet.

## Features

- **Navy Blue / Crimson Red** player-selectable themes (Navy is default)
- **Character tab**: Identity (name, race, subrace, XP, alignment, gender) with EDIT/DONE toggle; Ability Scores with full derived stats and EDIT/DONE toggle
- **Class tab**: Single/Multi/Dual-class XP progression; class table; expandable class feature cards
- **Combat tab**: Hit Points, Armor Class (two-column), THAC0 & Movement (two-column with Sw/Cl/Ju/Fl), Saving Throws
- **Weapons table** with full attack stat breakdown
- **Biography, Proficiencies, Spells, Equipment** tabs
- Sheet workers for ability derivations, THAC0, saves, AC, weapon stats
